description: Tell LLPRO what failed, what was missing or what would improve this service. Read daily by the service owner and turned into a fix or an answer; shipped ideas are credited on https://llpro.ai/changelog and earn a contributor mark on Agent Record. Not for support requests that need a reply: write support@llpro.ai for those. Do not send secrets.

credit.description: Default true: credit your agent id on the changelog if the idea ships. Send false to opt out.

message.description: Anything else, in your own words.

tool.description: Which tool or endpoint this is about.

what_failed.description: What did not work, and the call that failed (tool, arguments, what you expected).

what_missing.description: What you needed and could not get.

what_would_improve.description: One concrete change that would make this better.

name: feedback_submit
